scope: Keep the workspace address, folder search and keyboard focus useful as asynchronous folder observations arrive.

regression.result: Four failed and ten passed across fourteen file-panel tests. Failures reproduced a stale address, focus falling to the document after a folder row disappeared, Escape not clearing file search and a search carrying across observed folders.
regression.queue_submission: An earlier detached submission returned a delayed-receipt message; its receipt log reported database is locked. No matching host test process remained before resubmission. This was not a desktop test outcome.

implementation: Update an unedited address when a new observed folder arrives; retain paths typed by the user while observations change.
Clear the previous folder’s search when the observed path changes, while retaining a search across refreshes of the same folder.
Restore focus to the address only when the opened folder’s old row disappears and focus has fallen to the document. Preserve focus moved to another control.
Escape clears a nonempty file search before closing the enclosing details panel; leave composition keystrokes alone.

verification.checks: Root/E2E types, lint, Electron/renderer builds, file-panel tests and two native theme flows with zero retries and no accessibility violations.
verification.native_method: Owned Electron profiles and the existing authenticated local HTTP engine fixture. Status observations, workspace requests, UI navigation, focus and saved chat persistence use the production renderer and native bridge. Engine responses are simulated; no real sandbox/workflow backend was executed.

source_guard.qualification: Manual hashes sealed after lint/format preparation and compared after checks; not an immutable queue snapshot.

verification.full_validation: Pending exact-head CI after normal-hook commit and push; parent CI does not qualify this change.

limitations: No live engine/Temporal/sandbox/NSR acceptance; a designated CHAT_TEST workspace is still required.
No version/tag/release or update publication; v1.1.19 unchanged.
